name: Bradley County, AR
findings: Bradley County has 34 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bradley County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Health care organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 health care organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
